newsitem.title: USA: Coca-Cola to challenge Mountain Dew - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola to challenge Mountain Dew - NYT.

text.p: Coca-Cola is planning an assault on PepsiCo's Mountain Dew, The New York Times reported on Monday.
The new brand, to be called Surge, will, like Mountain Dew, be a greenish-yellow, citrus flavoured drink, the report said.
Mountain Dew had retail sales of $3 billion last year in the $52 billion industry, the newspaper said.
The story said Coca-Cola was planning a $50-million marketing campaign to start during the Super Bowl in late January.
